content.title: Enviri: Q3 Earnings Snapshot
content.summary: PHILADELPHIA (AP) — Enviri Corporation (NVRI) on Monday reported a loss of $22.3 million in its third quarter. The Philadelphia-based company said it had a loss of 28 cents per share. Losses, adjusted for non-recurring costs and to account for discontinued operations, came to 8 cents per share.
